ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark/grey pixels across the visible ventral surface area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern visible along both trailing edges; the right lobe exhibits higher pixel-amplitude variations and a more jagged profile compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curves tapering to acuminate tips with an upward terminal sweep.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular contouring and dense scarring on the distal right lobe tip, indicating historical tissue trauma or heavy parasitic encrustation.
other_distinctive_markers: A pair of vertically aligned, dark circular pigmentation spots on the left lobe, mid-ventral region.
